goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Integrated live QA on the 44-layer Seatify constellation passed preference defaults, alternate values, reload persistence, restore defaults, logical/exact click depth, contain/touch marquee behavior at 100% and 150%, synchronized multi-selection, outline hiding/restoration, clean history/dirty state, and an empty console. Strict malformed/future storage fallback, serialization stripping, focus-loop variants, reduced motion, and gesture regressions pass automated coverage and independent review. Final npm run check passes 20 files and 371 tests. The only remaining oracle item is a real human Command-drag over the selected overlay because the browser helper cannot carry Command through drag.
evidence: Alternate preference values and restored defaults each survived full reload.
Logical and exact clicks selected different expected hierarchy levels on identical nested geometry.
Contain versus touch marquee diverged correctly at 100%, and touching passed again at 150%.
Two-layer selection remained intact while individual markers were hidden and restored.
Undo, Redo, and Save stayed disabled; browser console warnings/errors were empty.
npm run check passed 20 files, 371 tests, typecheck, and build.
facts: Browser security policy forbids direct local-storage inspection or mutation; strict corruption/future-version behavior is proven by focused tests instead.
T005/T014 and current automated coverage provide the gesture, serialization, and cancellation regression evidence not reliably repeatable with the current browser driver.
A real human Command-drag over .svg_select_shape is still mandatory before completion.
